articles.title: JNTU-Hyderabad scholar seeks vigilance probe into security tender irregularities
articles.description: A JNTU-Hyderabad research scholar has sought a vigilance probe into alleged irregularities in the university's security services tender. The complaint alleges repeated tender cancellations, nomination-based contract award without competitive bidding and the removal of the chief engineer

articles.title: T.N. government invites tenders for coverage of Assembly proceedings for two years
articles.description: T.N. government invites tenders for recording and post-production work of Assembly proceedings for two years.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu Cancels Rs 30 Crore Book Tender Amid Corruption Allegations
articles.description: The Tamil Nadu government has scrapped a Rs 30 crore book procurement tender for the Kamarajar Grand Library following corruption allegations and reports of substandard, AI-generated books being supplied to state libraries.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu Government cancels Rs 30-crore book procurement for Trichy Kamarajar Grand Library
articles.description: The Tamil Nadu government has cancelled book procurement tenders worth Rs 30 crore for the Kamarajar Grand Library and Intellectual Centre being constructed in Tiruchirappalli following allegations of irregularities in the purchase of books for public libraries across the state The procurement process for books worth Rs 30 crore had been initiated during the previous DMK-led regime for the library which is being constructed at an estimated cost of Rs 290 crore in Tiruchirappalli

articles.title: Tamil Nadu cancels Rs 30 crore book order for Tiruchirappalli library
articles.description: Tamil Nadu cancels Rs 30 crore book tenders for Tiruchirappalli’s Kamarajar Grand Library amid procurement irregularity allegations and a DVAC probe.

articles.title: Textbook Corporation Cancels ₹250 Crore Paper Tender In Bhopal After Suppliers Quote 17% Higher Rates, Fresh Bidding Planned
articles.description: The Madhya Pradesh Textbook Corporation cancelled a ₹250 crore paper procurement tender after four suppliers quoted prices 17% higher than last year, exceeding the technical committee's estimated 8–12% increase. Fresh bidding is planned to secure reasonable rates. Existing paper stocks can sustain textbook printing for approximately one to one-and-a-half months.

articles.title: MSME Ministry reviews CPSE procurement from SC/ST enterprises to meet mandated target
articles.description: Joint Secretary Mercy Epao chaired a review at Dr. Ambedkar International Centre on November 5, 2026, with 30 PSUs on the four per cent SC/ST MSE procurement target.

articles.title: MSME Ministry reviews CPSE procurement from SC/ST enterprises to meet mandated target
articles.description: Central Public Sector Enterprises gathered in the national capital to assess and accelerate their procurement compliance under the mandated four per cent target reserved for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Micro and Small Enterprises according to the Ministry of Micro Small and Medium Enterprises MSME The Ministry of MSME convened the review session at the Dr Ambedkar International Centre on November 5 2026 Chaired by Joint Secretary Mercy Epao the round table brought together officials from the Ministry the Department of Public Enterprises the National Small Industries Corporation and the Government e-Marketplace to address operational hurdles and examine compliance under the Public Procurement Policy

articles.title: MSME Ministry reviews CPSE procurement from SC/ST enterprises to meet mandated target
articles.description: Central Public Sector Enterprises gathered in the national capital to assess and accelerate their procurement compliance under the mandated four per cent target reserved for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Micro and Small Enterprises, according to the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME).
